# OIYO News (news.oiyo.net)

> Daily curated news and market briefs plus maintained AI model, tool, and AI-native
> systems references. News pages are source-linked and date-specific; reference pages
> explain the real harness, company brain, verification loops, prompts, and playbooks.

## Key pages
- https://news.oiyo.net/ — daily curated technology, economy, and market briefs
- https://news.oiyo.net/ai/ — AI models, tools, curation, and practical FAQ
- https://news.oiyo.net/ai/models/ — curated model catalog and Dataset landing page
- https://news.oiyo.net/systems/ — real AI-native company architecture
- https://news.oiyo.net/systems/manual/ — setup, agents, brain, gates, loops, prompts
- https://news.oiyo.net/systems/playbooks/ — reusable operational playbooks

## OIYO family
oiyo.net (tests & tools) · blog.oiyo.net (guides) · wiki.oiyo.net (dictionary)
· game.oiyo.net (games) · news.oiyo.net (news, AI, and systems)
